description.message: Collect the page you’re viewing, images on it, and selected text into Collage. Also opens pages that need sign-in or scripts in the background for Collage, and fetches subtitles that require sign-in.

notConnected.message: Not connected to Collage. Open the Collage app and try again

savedQueued.message: Saved; Collage will collect it when it opens

savedLater.message: Saved; Collage will collect it shortly

readerLine1.message: Collage reads pages in this window in the background

readerLine2.message: It closes itself after a few idle minutes
